modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 4, 1996: The first flight of Ariane 5 explodes after roughly 37 seconds. It was a Cluster mission.
On June 4, 1896: Henry Ford completes the Ford Quadricycle, his first gasoline-powered automobile, and also gives it a successful test run.
June 4 is observed as The Flag Day of the Finnish Defence Forces, also known as the birthday of C. G. E. Mannerheim, Marshal of Finland (Finland).
June 4 is observed as Trianon Treaty Day (Romania).
On June 4, 2010: Falcon 9 Flight 1 is the maiden flight of the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, which launches from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station Space Launch Complex 40.
